About the Saturday Shop Ride (Montclair Bikery) group ride

A weekend road ride from the shop, A or B pace depending on the group. Routes are posted in the shop's WhatsApp chat; call the shop to get the link. Self-supported: bring your own flat kit, food and water. Helmets required. Cancelled for wet roads or freezing temps.
